paper_metadata.title: Toughening and strengthening behavior of an Nb–8Si–20Ti–6Hf alloy with addition of Cr

evidence.quote: Investigations on the microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of multi-component Nb–8Si–20Ti–6Hf–(6,10,14)Cr alloys at room and high temperatures were carried out in this work.
Button ingots of Nb–8Si–20Ti–6Hf–(6,10,14)Cr alloys (referred to as 6Cr, 10Cr and 14Cr alloys hereafter, respectively) were prepared by arc-melting in an argon atmosphere under a pressure of ~0.5 Pa.
